format.name: sentilab-agent-research-content
format.kind: descriptive JSON content packet; not a deployed API schema or ENGRAM format

scope: Original chiplet placement/thermal simulation against reconstructed computational references; no manufacturer CAD, silicon measurement or general agent-superiority claim.

status.ENGRAM_projection: pending owner implementation and schema evidence
status.historical_temperature_scope: New validation applies only to its bound evaluator/record; it cannot retroactively validate historical temperatures.

physics.equation: G(x; package, materials, mesh) theta = p
assumptions: ambient boundary forcing is represented by theta; an absolute-T formulation must retain it

generated_package_rule.status: conditional source generator rule, not an observed runtime configuration

physics.runtime_binding: Bind generated config/layer/input bytes, source, binary/build, host and statistic per result; defaults are not runtime evidence.

geometry_contract.lattice_basis: declared finite engineering benchmark choice; not manufacturing tolerance or position uncertainty
geometry_contract.rotation: 0 or 90 degrees about centre; swap width/height; squares allow only 0
checks: body gap along at least one axis
geometry_contract.raw_exception: Only separately identified reference work omits the lattice test; all other geometry rules still apply.

candidate_design_format.name: sentilab-open-proposal/1
candidate_design_format.status: design specification only; shipped validator/adapter not established
candidate_design_format.meaning: centers_um[i] and rot_deg[i] describe die i; this is not a submission.

problems.title: Ascend 910 research reconstruction

engineering_example.role: legal engineering example; not paper match
engineering_example.rounding: nearest 0.5 mm; ties +infinity; rotations retained; no repair

history_1mm.role: retained historical legal variant; not the paper layout

problems.model_limit: TAP model dimensions/powers; omits the two unpowered dummy dies, so their lateral heat path is absent.

problems.title: CPU-DRAM research design

engineering_example.role: legal engineering example; not paper match
engineering_example.rounding: nearest 0.5 mm; ties +infinity; rotations retained; no repair

history_1mm.role: retained historical legal variant; not the paper layout

problems.model_limit: TAP model of a published research proposal; dimensions and powers are modelling assumptions.

T_M.definition: max of native GRID_CENTER mapped temperatures over exactly the listed real Chiplet_i units
T_M.mapping: mean of 1, 2 or 4 central cells per die
T_M.interpretation: centre-mapped statistic, not the pointwise physical peak

active_grid_peak.definition: maximum cell temperature on active chip layer 4, with row/column argmax

W.definition: total routed length in mm; each ordered pair with matrix[i][j]>0 is a directed net weighted by that wire count
W.acceptance: HiGHS MILP proved optimum with mip_rel_gap=0 within the solver limit; otherwise UNKNOWN

W_proxy.definition: weighted mean Euclidean centre distance; each unordered pair counted once
W_proxy.role: diagnostic only; never substitute for routed W

comparison.reference_pair: T_M(R) and W(R) must use the same reference geometry and fixed evaluator as c; do not substitute paper targets.

bounds.status: no accepted bounds; unknown is never zero

bounded_formulas.q_bound: b_c+(1+r)*b_R if b_c,b_R are valid individual wire-error bounds and r>=0

screen.nominal: c and R at grid64; paired T_M and W
screen.mesh: c and R at grid32; T_M
screen.position: one raw-reference die, one axis, +/-500 um; nominal c versus that perturbed R; pair its T_M and routed W
screen.replay: fresh evaluator process; replay is not physical validation
rules: freeze transforms, exclusions and hashes before outcomes
exclude continuously illegal reference moves before outcomes
no snapping, repair, empty-set pass or outcome-selected omissions
finite sampled sensitivities are not uniform error bounds or confidence intervals

intended_claims.preconditions: required legality, gate-zero, source/input/statistic binding and predicate checks; each required scenario complete

bounded_predicates.wire_improvement_with_thermal_tolerance: q_0_upper<=-B_W AND d_upper<=D; relaxed if D>0
bounded_predicates.robust_dominance: q_0_upper<=0 AND d_upper<=0, with one strict improvement under a frozen margin/tie rule

intended_claims.without_bounds: Evaluate the corresponding nominal predicate separately in every frozen scenario; label only passes the listed sensitivity cases.
intended_claims.independence: Temperature target is independent of wire. Unexpected diagnostics do not suppress valid claims; failed required evidence does.
intended_claims.reproduction: two-sided reference reproduction is separate from one-sided non-inferiority
intended_claims.tradeoffs: Separate strict, relaxed and nondominated results. Nested budgets are not independent wins or global optimality.

policy.qualification: Policy choices, not measured uncertainty or significance. 85 C is a chosen simulation target, not a hardware/safety limit. Freeze before scoring.

paper.citation: Ma et al., TAP-2.5D, DATE 2021, pp.1246-1251

upstream_TAP.license: Apache-2.0; retain applicable notices for any source redistribution

provenance.extraction: Vector reconstruction assumes frame/drawing order. Routed agreement is consistency evidence, not absolute-coordinate identification. Sampled sensitivity is not figure-to-silicon uncertainty.
provenance.identities: Source file SHA256, canonical layout content hash, controller design hash, proposed submission geometry hash and runtime-input hash are different domains.
provenance.rights: Retain original licenses/notices. No paper is bundled and no additional source, data or training rights are granted.
